ran: One Agent dispatch per case to a user agent 'probe', main model claude-sonnet-5-5: frontmatter only (s1), frontmatter vs CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (s2), per-invocation model 'opus' vs both (s3), env var with no frontmatter model (s4), neither (s5), model: inherit vs env var (s6), env var from a User env block vs frontmatter (s7).
result: The per-invocation parameter won (claude-opus-5-5), then frontmatter (claude-haiku-5-5) over the env var, then the env var (claude-fable-5-1), then the main model. model: inherit beat the env var and ran the main model.
method: dashboard/experiments/harness: claude -p in a throwaway HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project under $TMPDIR, a fake key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on 127.0.0.1. fakeapi.py logs the model, output_config.effort and cache_control ttl of each request and answers 400; for agent cases it first streams one Agent tool call. The harness only allows requests to fakeapi.py on 127.0.0.1. Managed settings were not tested, because writing them needs admin rights.
